title: If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization
abstract: arXiv:2609.23376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) grounds a text-queried event in time from video, audio, and language. The supervision sources available to this task can differ in temporal-boundary reliability: on OV-AVEBench, our configured visual teacher gives more reliable boundary cues than the configured audio teacher, although the latter is a strong pretrained audio model and remains semantically informative. This is a setting-specific diagnostic rather than a universal ranking of vision and audio. We formulate the resulting challenge as supervision placement: which teacher signals may shape the localization decision, and which should remain auxiliary. Based on this view, we propose OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric distillation framework. Visual feature transfer shapes a decision-aligned representation, audio feature transfer enriches a complementary auxiliary subspace, a text prototype anchors seen/unseen categ

translated_title: 若闻其声，助寻其踪：面向开放词汇音视频事件定位的正交知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 开放词汇音视频事件定位（OV-AVEL）旨在从视频、音频和语言中，将文本查询的事件在时间轴上进行定位。该任务可用的监督来源在时间边界的可靠性上可能存在差异：在OV-AVEBench上，我们配置的视觉教师模型比配置的音频教师模型能提供更可靠的边界线索，尽管后者是一个强大的预训练音频模型，仍然具有丰富的语义信息。这是针对特定设置的诊断结论，而非对视觉与音频模态的普遍性排序。我们将由此产生的挑战表述为“监督放置”问题：哪些教师信号可以塑造定位决策，哪些应保持辅助作用。基于这一视角，我们提出了OV-OrthKD，一个可靠性感知的非对称蒸馏框架。视觉特征迁移塑造与决策对齐的表示，音频特征迁移丰富互补的辅助子空间，文本原型锚定已见/未见类别……
tldr: 提出OV-OrthKD，一种可靠性感知的非对称正交知识蒸馏框架，让边界线索更可靠的视觉教师信号主导定位决策，同时将音频信号作为互补的辅助子空间，从而提升开放词汇音视频事件定位的性能。
en_tdlr: OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric orthogonal knowledge distillation framework, lets the visual teacher with more reliable boundary cues shape the localization decision while audio signals enrich a complementary auxiliary subspace, improving open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization.
